comparisons.comparison: Both companies disclose their global employee headcounts as a key aspect of their Human Capital Management in Item 1, highlighting the scale of their workforce. NVIDIA reported approximately 29,600 employees as of the end of fiscal year 2024, while AMD reported approximately 28,000 employees as of December 28, 2024. Both disclosures serve to quantify the workforce size, though NVIDIA's disclosure in the 'Employee Value Proposition' summary context also emphasizes R&D concentration (22,200 employees), whereas AMD's candidate disclosure focuses strictly on the total global count.
